word_limit_counts: Including footnotes; excluding abstract, references, tables and figures
word_limit_quote: Research articles should not exceed 9,000 words (including footnotes, but not including abstract, references, tables and figures). Re-read on the guidelines page 2026-09-06.
measured_2026_09_06: Body 5,525 words excluding tables, counted from the apaquarto .docx render (paragraphs between the Introduction and the References heading, table cells attributed separately: 5,009 further words sit in tables). Five figures and four tables, both within the limit of five each.
required_sections: Title page: short title, title, authors and affiliations, acknowledgements paragraph, corresponding author's postal and email address, competing interests declaration

Ethics statement: 'The authors assert that all procedures contributing to this work comply with the ethical standards of the relevant national and institutional committees on human experimentation and with the Helsinki Declaration of 1975, as revised in 2008.' plus committee name and approval number at submission
Data availability statement at the end of the manuscript
Supplementary material statement before the acknowledgements; files supplied separately as Figure S1, Table S1
Generative AI declaration: tool name and version, dates used, access, full description; in acknowledgements (text), Methods (analysis), captions (images)
reporting_standard: ANOVAs by participants (F1) and items (F2); mixed models with intercepts by participants and items; accuracy data by categorical models; no pre-decimal zero for p and r
review_model: Single anonymised; normally three external reviewers; no anonymisation of the manuscript
highlights: Required at submission: 3 to 5 bullets, at most 85 characters each including spaces (submission/highlights.md)
cover_letter: Required, with a short paragraph on the main contribution and its interest for BLC readers (submission/cover_letter.md)
supplementary_files: Not typeset; fewer than ten files, normally under 3 MB in total; each referred to at least once in the print version (supplement.qmd)
open_science_badges: Open Data and Open Materials badges available
related_submissions: Work must not be under consideration elsewhere; Cambridge editorial policies do not address companion manuscripts, so disclose in the cover letter and upload the companion as a file not for publication
notes: British or American spelling, consistently. Headings numbered to two levels at most, only the initial word capitalised. Captions 'Figure 1. Title'. Alt-text may be supplied by the authors at submission (submission/alt_text.md).
